risks.risk: The rear light may be broken or non-functional
risks.proof: A photo of the rear light illuminated
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken rear light

risks.risk: The front suspension or handlebars may be damaged
risks.proof: A photo of the front of the scooter

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have high mileage
risks.proof: A photo of the engine and a video of the scooter running

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the front of the scooter showing the handlebars and front suspension.
Photo of the engine and the underside of the scooter.
Video of the scooter starting and running.
Photo of the rear light illuminated.
reading.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
